conditions: 6 AM—Up and at 'em, Jackson! Don't be dissuaded by the soggy situation down in the valley. Because April continues its winter assault on Rendezvous Mountain, helping to boost your face-shot tally. 3 new inches have already been slathered across the upper elevations, and heavy snowfall is expected to continue during the early hours. Precipitation will wane this afternoon with the chance of a few stray sunbeams piercing the cloudcover. Morning temperatures will hover in the mid-20s at the summit and the upper 30s in Teton Village before dipping slightly. Gusty southwest winds will be on the increase as the weather pulls out of the area, eventually blasting in the 15-40 mph range. Let the aerial tram take you on a magical trip. But beware; addiction to an alpine dopamine drip is the true cost of membership. -Lege
